name: Lambeth
text: Lambeth is a district in South London, England, which today also gives its name to the larger London Borough of Lambeth. Lambeth itself was an ancient parish in the county of Surrey. It is situated 1 mile (1.6 km) south of Charing Cross, across the river from Westminster Palace.

depictions.name: Lambeth
depictions.text: Lambeth is one of the 32 boroughs of London. Once a sparsely-populated wasteland, it became a rural area in reconstruction, bustling with commerce and life during the Industrial Revolution. The region included an asylum that the twin British Assassins Jacob and Evie Frye visited.
